description: This Java interface defines Data Access Object (DAO) methods for managing category options in a Room database, specifically for note categories including updating and retrieving sorting preferences.

classes.name: CategoryOptionsDao
classes.description: Interface providing database access methods for category options, including adding options, modifying sorting methods, and retrieving current sorting preferences.

methods.name: addCategoryOptions
methods.description: Inserts a new CategoryOptions entity into the database.

methods.name: modifyCategoryOrder
methods.description: Updates the sorting method for a specific category and account ID.

methods.name: getCategoryOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the current sorting method for a given category and account ID as LiveData.
